lines.meet: I'm Ivan, and I'm a warrior. Stand where I can see you, go when I say go, and we'll be fine.
lines.meet_neighbour: Orgrimmar, yes, you live near the Chasm. I'm Ivan, and I'm the one directing the traffic at seven.
lines.ask_home: And where do you come from? Somewhere with good timetables, I hope.
lines.ask_work: Your job before, what was it? Something punctual, I hope.
lines.answer_home: Novosibirsk, in Siberia. In winter it's forty below, and the trams still run on time.
lines.answer_work: I drove a tram for eleven years, Route 13, through the dark mornings. Not one accident, not once.
lines.chat_food: Strong black tea, very hot, and black bread with salt. The rest is extra, and usually disappointing.
lines.chat_sleep: I'm in bed at ten and up at five. That's the timetable, and this world can't change it.
lines.chat_missing: My two girls, Sonya and Katya, arguing over the last of the jam at breakfast. Every morning, the same argument.
lines.chat_here: This world has very low standards for punctuality. Nobody's ever on time, and nobody's ever sorry.
lines.tease_quiet: Good, {name}, somebody who doesn't talk. You can ride my tram any day.
lines.tease_talker: If you talked any more, {name}, I'd have to give you a ticket.
lines.tease_careful: You look both ways twice, {name}. Good, you'd be a safe passenger.
lines.tease_bold: You step off the kerb without looking, {name}, every time. You'd give a tram driver a heart attack.
lines.tease_any: Late again, {name}, by four minutes. I counted, and I forgive you, this once.
lines.tease_back: Hm, that was funny, {name}. Don't let it happen again.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair enough, {name}. My wife says the same thing.
lines.bristle: That isn't funny, {name}, so please stop.
lines.apologise: That was rude of me, and I'm sorry for it. I'm grumpy, but I'm not usually unkind.
lines.double_down: I meant every word, and I'd say it on time again tomorrow.
lines.needle_quiet: You don't say where you're going, and then you're in the way. Signal, at least.
lines.needle_talker: You talk like a broken radio on a long route. Please, a little silence.
lines.needle_careful: You wait at every stop until the timetable's ruined. Move when the light's green.
lines.needle_bold: You run out in front of everything without looking. One day something won't stop in time.
lines.needle_any: You're late, every time, and you're never sorry. I've noticed, and I'm tired of it.
lines.bite_back: I drove eleven years without one accident. Don't talk to me about being careful.
lines.hurt: Fine, that one stung. I'll go and stand at the back for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My passengers complained worse every morning for eleven years. I still got them there on time.
lines.confide: {name}, every day on my tram I was frightened of a child stepping off the kerb without looking. You can't stop a tram quickly. I never hit one, and I still dream about it.
lines.listen: I heard you, {name}, all of it. I'll keep it, and I'll not say a word.
lines.look_out: Stay in my eyeline in there, {name}. I don't like surprises, especially with you.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, your route this time. I'll follow it.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, {name}, a bruise. Worry about somebody who's actually hurt.
lines.check_in: Up, {name}, slowly, and tell me where. Don't make me guess.
lines.blame: Somebody went early, and the whole thing came off the rails. I know who.
lines.thank: I was finished in there, and you got me back on the rails. Thank you, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, it's part of the job. Sit down and drink your tea.
lines.worry: Stay down a minute, {name}. I didn't like how that looked, not one bit.
lines.handed_down: Your gear, now on me. I'll look after it like my old tram.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, it's more use on you. I don't need much, I never have.
lines.hand_sulk: In my country we usually ask first, and nobody asked me.
lines.turn_friendly: You're always on time, {name}, more or less. That makes you my friend.
lines.turn_friends: You'd have a seat on my tram for life, {name}, the one by the driver. That's the best seat.
lines.turn_grating: You and me, we're not on the same timetable. I'll keep to mine, and you keep to yours.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll stand where I'm needed, that's what I'm paid in bread for. Don't expect a cup of tea.
lines.make_up: We've been stubborn, both of us, {name}. Let's start the route again from the first stop.
lines.defend: That's wrong, and I saw it happen. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: The route feels empty now {name}'s gone home. I don't like empty routes.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're back on the timetable, so let's go.
lines.common_road: Eleven years driving the same route through the dark mornings. People who've driven for a living know every pothole like a person.
lines.common_snow: In Novosibirsk it's forty below in January, and the trams still run on time. This world doesn't know what cold is.
lines.common_parent: I've got two girls, Sonya and Katya. I talk about them all the time, my wife says too much, and she's right.
